The '''Battle of Chazwa''' was a battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Following a [[Battle of Basilisk (Jedi Civil War)|victory]] at [[Basilisk]], the Republic launched a campaign from that planet to meet the advancing Sith forces who were advancing down the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] toward [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]]. There, the two sides fought with the Republic emerging as the victors.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Chazwa makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.<ref name="EA" />
